athletePage.swcNote: The SWC band (Smallest Worthwhile Change) represents normal variability. Points above indicate good recovery, points below indicate fatigue or stress.
athletePage.pmcNote: Peak race zone: TSB between +5 and +25 (green area). CTL = fitness (42-day average), ATL = fatigue (7-day average), TSB = form (CTL minus ATL).
athletePage.pmcNeed: At least 4 weeks of data are needed for the Performance Management Chart.

threshold.zonesManual: Zones edited by hand by the professional
threshold.stale: The test is more than 90 days old ({days}): it is worth repeating it.
threshold.noneSaved: No thresholds saved to the profile: they are saved from the app, from the results of a test with a reliable estimate.
threshold.noTests: No incremental test with threshold estimate has been run yet.

reasons.notEnoughData: Less than 10 minutes of valid data after the warm-up.
reasons.tooManyArtifacts: Too many windows discarded for artifacts: the strap was loose or dry.
reasons.sensorNoRr: The sensor was not transmitting RR intervals.
reasons.noDescendingTract: Alpha1 does not show a steady decline as HR rises.
reasons.lowR2: The line fits the data poorly (R² below 0.6).
reasons.vt1NotReached: Intensity reached was insufficient: alpha1 never dropped below 0.75.
reasons.vt2NotReached: The test did not reach the second threshold: alpha1 never dropped below 0.50.
reasons.vt1Extrapolated: The estimated HR would fall more than 5 bpm outside the observed data: no extrapolation.
reasons.vt2Extrapolated: The estimated HR would fall more than 5 bpm outside the observed data: no extrapolation.
reasons.inconsistent: VT2 is not above VT1: inconsistent estimate, not saved.

threshold.methodNote: Threshold estimate based on DFA alpha1 (Rogers et al. 2021). DFA alpha1 alone tends to place the first threshold a few beats higher than a laboratory test. For maximum precision the reference remains the cardiopulmonary exercise test.
threshold.estimatedSubtitle: {mode} · from DFA alpha1 during the test
threshold.noEstimate: Test run without threshold estimate: the sensor was not transmitting the RR intervals needed for DFA alpha1.
threshold.unreliable: Unreliable estimate (R² {r2}, below {min}): the data is shown, the thresholds are not saved.
threshold.noSignal: Signal not sufficient to estimate the thresholds
threshold.correctedNote: * intensity corrected by the athlete during the test
threshold.recoveryMissing: Recovery not recorded: the test was closed before 60 seconds.
threshold.recoveryDetail: HR at stop {stop} bpm, at 60 s {hr60} bpm
threshold.recoveryRmssd: RMSSD in the first 5 minutes of recovery {value} ms
threshold.recoveryReading: Reading: 25 bpm or more is good, 13 to 24 average, 12 or less to improve (literature thresholds, the same as in the app). Recovery improves with aerobic training.
threshold.zonesText: The boundaries of the five DFA zones (1.0 · 0.75 · 0.50 · 0.30) converted to HR with the same line as the test. A boundary outside the observed data is not invented: the zone is merged with its neighbor.
threshold.zonesNone: Zones not available without an estimate.

chart.trendNoData: At least two tests are needed for a trend
